name: ZoomInfo Sales
description: ZoomInfo Sales is the B2B sales-intelligence product within the ZoomInfo go-to-market platform, combining a large contact/company database with buyer-intent tracking, website-visitor identification, conversation intelligence, and sales engagement automation.
best_for: Sales and RevOps teams that want a large B2B contact database combined with intent signals, conversation intelligence, and engagement automation in one platform.
features: Verified B2B database described as 420M+ contacts, 120M+ direct dials, and 145M+ companies, filterable by 300+ attributes
Conversation intelligence via Chorus, analyzing calls, meetings, and emails
Sales engagement automation and a dialer via Engage, for multi-touch cadences
Signal-triggered workflows (buying intent, technology installs) that launch automated outreach
ZoomInfo Copilot, an AI feature for account prioritization and message drafting
One-click CRM export/sync and a Chrome extension for in-context prospecting
pros: States a very large contact/company database (420M+ contacts, 145M+ companies) with 300+ filterable attributes, per its product page
Bundles data, buyer intent, conversation intelligence (Chorus), and engagement automation (Engage) in one platform rather than as separate purchases
Displays ISO 27701, GDPR, and CCPA compliance badges directly on its own homepage
cons: This entry's dedicated pricing page (zoominfo.com/pricing) returned an automated bot-verification challenge that could not be accessed, so no numeric self-serve price could be confirmed firsthand; other pages consistently route to "Contact Sales" or a free-trial signup form instead
Multiple similarly-named ZoomInfo products (Sales, Marketing, Talent, Operations) can make it unclear which specific capabilities are bundled into the Sales product without a sales conversation
"Free trial" is offered as a lead-gen signup rather than a persistent free plan

faq.question: Does ZoomInfo Sales publish its pricing?
faq.answer: Not verifiably. Its dedicated pricing page is gated behind an automated bot-check that this review could not pass, and its other marketing pages route to "Contact Sales" or a free-trial signup rather than showing dollar amounts.

faq.question: How large is ZoomInfo's contact database?
faq.answer: ZoomInfo's own Sales product page states access to 420M+ global contacts, including 120M+ direct dials, and 145M+ companies, filterable by 300+ attributes.

faq.question: What is Chorus by ZoomInfo?
faq.answer: Chorus is ZoomInfo's conversation-intelligence product, listed as a core feature of ZoomInfo Sales for analyzing customer calls, meetings, and emails.

alternatives.name: Apollo.io
alternatives.description: A sales intelligence and engagement platform combining a B2B contact database with sequencing, a dialer, and AI-assisted prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want published self-serve pricing and a bundled dialer/sequencing layer alongside contact data.

alternatives.name: Cognism
alternatives.description: A B2B sales intelligence platform built around phone-verified, compliance-vetted contact data, especially for European prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams prioritizing compliance-vetted, phone-verified data over raw database size, especially in Europe.

alternatives.name: Gong
alternatives.description: A revenue intelligence platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk and inform forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want conversation intelligence as a dedicated, standalone product rather than bundled with a data platform.
